reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Payment Methodology for Inpatient Hospital Services
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Florida Medicaid uses APR-DRGs for most acute inpatient hospital stays. The stay is generally paid as one bundled DRG payment, but unusually high-cost cases may qualify for outlier payment. Transfer status, non-covered days, charge cap, and HCAC repricing can change the final amount.

recommended_action.description: Recommendation 1: Adopt a DRG/transplant carve-out edit: keep rare catastrophic inpatient cases in bundled "DRG" payment by default, but route any case in the "same inpatient stay" and "transplant phase" to the "transplant global fee" for up to "365 days transplant-related care" only at an "approved transplant center" rather than repricing it as standard DRG reimbursement. Exempt: global transplant fee, standard DRG reimbursement.
